definition: The bioluminescent algae bloom that spreads across Lake Michigan each summer, repurposed by Zheng-Dao Bioelectric as a passive energy collection medium. In the Shelf, it's the only ambient light visible from the lower walkways at night and has become a symbol of melancholy beauty.
origin: Geographic/environmental, romanticized in Shelf street poetry and music
usage: Poetic and geographic reference across tiers; Zheng-Dao uses it in branding
example: She sat at the edge of the platform watching the lakelight pulse — green and slow, like the city was breathing.
